title: Negative: witness sketches of four shape phases of round object over Columbus, 2 Aug 48
description: Negative photostat of a typed account of a round object, 20 to 30 ft in diameter with a grey-black perimeter, seen moving south over Columbus on 2 Aug 48. Below an "Agent's Note" are four outline sketches labeled "First" (a flat rectangle), "Second", "Third" and "Fourth" (progressively rounder ovals). The caption reads "The above drawings constitute four positions of one phase. The object passed thru three of these phases during the 15 minute period."
